answer: Per-operator cost ledger aggregation: wallets are free to create, but each operator must post a single refundable lantern bond covering its total fleet, with payout proportional to verified activity the ledger can trace. Sybil clusters reveal one operator via shared funding traces, and the bond is debited per extra identity beyond a pearl threshold, so the operator pays the whole ledge at once while honest wallets pay nothing. Attack cost = fleet size × threshold penalty, scaling linearly with identities.
